comparability.consequence: Absolute cost measures (applicationCpuSeconds, latency milliseconds, hostCpuSeconds) are NOT poolable across hosts. Only within-host paired posture deltas, and their normalized/relative forms, may be compared across hosts. A host effect is an experimental factor, never noise to normalize away.

dockerGidNote: 999 on fb14srv5 and 998 on fb14srv4/fb14srv6 is NOT a contradiction: Debian allocates the docker group from the descending system-GID range at install time, so the value depends on package install order on each machine. Three SUTs holding two values for 'the' docker gid is three correct per-host answers, not two answers to one question.
